title: Windows 95 Button
accessibility_notes: These recreate deprecated tags accessibly: motion respects prefers-reduced-motion and nothing depends on blinking to be readable.
ai_usage: Retro-desktop UIs. The 1px content shift on press is what made these buttons feel physical; the dotted inner focus ring is the era-correct focus indicator.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Windows 95 Button</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "bevel-button-95",
    "title": "Windows 95 Button",
    "summary": "The outset/inset bevel button.",
    "description": "The outset/inset bevel button.",
    "theme": "retro-web",
    "categories": ["retro", "nostalgia"],
    "tags": ["retro", "nostalgia", "windows-95", "bevel", "button", "skeuomorphic"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "1990s",
    "difficulty": "beginner",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "These recreate deprecated tags accessibly: motion respects prefers-reduced-motion and nothing depends on blinking to be readable.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--bg", "description": "Face colour", "default": "#c0c0c0" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Retune through the custom properties", "Scale for a compact variant"],
    "ai_usage": "Retro-desktop UIs. The 1px content shift on press is what made these buttons feel physical; the dotted inner focus ring is the era-correct focus indicator."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    .fx { padding: .4rem 1.4rem; background: #c0c0c0; color: #000; border: 2px outset #fff;
      font-family: "MS Sans Serif", Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: .82rem; cursor: pointer; }
    .fx:active { border-style: inset; padding: .45rem 1.35rem .35rem 1.45rem; }
    .fx:focus-visible { outline: 1px dotted #000; outline-offset: -5px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="fx" type="button">OK</button>
</body>
</html>
